title: Start freelancing with a focused niche
tips: Choose one clear service (for example: Python scripting, logo design, or blog writing).
Create 2-3 portfolio samples focused on that service before sending many proposals.
Use a profile headline that states your skill + result (e.g. 'Python Developer for Automation and Data Tasks').
suggestions: Help me draft my first profile headline
How should I write my first proposal?
What projects should I add to portfolio first?

title: Proposal structure that gets responses
tips: Start with the client's goal, not your biography.
Mention one relevant proof project with measurable output.
Offer a simple 2-3 step plan and expected timeline.
checklist: End with one question to start conversation
suggestions: Give me a proposal template for programming tasks
How can I improve proposal openings?
What mistakes should I avoid in proposals?

title: Improve portfolio quality
tips: Each project should explain problem, approach, tools, and output.
Add screenshots/snippets and keep descriptions short and outcome-focused.
Prioritize projects aligned with your strongest assessment domain.
checklist: Write problem → solution → result for each project
suggestions: How do I rewrite project descriptions?
Which project should be my featured one?
How many projects are enough to start?

title: 4-week practical learning path
tips: Week 1: fundamentals + one mini exercise daily.
Week 3: build one independent project and document it.
Week 4: polish portfolio + proposals and apply to small gigs.
checklist: Publish each project with short write-up
suggestions: Build me a roadmap for my recommended domain
What should I practice daily for 30 minutes?
How do I balance tasks and learning?

title: Task completion and submission quality
tips: Break tasks into small checkpoints: understand, build, test, polish.
Before submitting, run a short self-check against task requirements.
Use mentor feedback to create a 'mistakes to avoid' checklist.
suggestions: How can I reduce repeated mistakes?
